derivation: STANDARDS-DERIVED. Every field traces to a standard, a regulation or a recognised industry body per campaign/SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PACK.md. Citation statuses observe source_status_ceiling in vocabulary.json. Nothing is generalised from a client programme or a product.
field_set: EN 17007:2017 cl. 5.2 maintenance process profile, corroborated by ISO 9001:2015 cl. 4.4.1 a) to h).
gaps: ANSI A300 (tree care operations, including Part 7 IVM) and ANSI Z133 (arboricultural safety) are the usual industry specifications for method and finish. Neither is in the Source Authority Pack, so neither is cited. Prescription finish, IVM method and pruning practice are therefore judgment.

No federal distribution vegetation clearance distance exists. 16 U.S.C. 824o excludes local distribution from the ERO. NERC FAC-003 MVCD is transmission. OSHA 1910.269 Tables R-5 to R-8 are worker minimum approach distances, not vegetation-to-conductor clearances. NESC Rule 218 Vegetation management is cited by title only; its body is paywalled and is not paraphrased into a distance or a cycle.
The pack's Pennsylvania line 'vegetation 8yr' is imprecise. 52 Pa. Code sec. 57.198(n)(1) is a 4-to-8-year inspection and treatment cycle plus a condition-based plan. That is the text used here.
California vegetation clearances live in CPUC GO 95 Rule 35, which is not in the pack. The pack lists GO 165 (inspection of facilities). GO 95 is not cited.

APQC PCF Utilities v7.2.1 has no vegetation-management process. The only touch is 10.4.5 waste and hazardous goods (pcf_id 16970), which this model covers only as 7.4.4 debris. A whole specialised category with no APQC home is a taxonomy finding, not a missing group to add.
GFMAM 6.5 Maintenance Delivery is mapped in the crosswalk to 1.0-5.0 and 8.0 and does not list 7.0. Vegetation is maintenance delivery. The crosswalk is thin here, not the category.
Hazard tree / danger tree has no definition in the pack. Identification criteria at 7.2.3 are judgment.

Remote survey (LiDAR, satellite, drone), growth modelling, notice content, refusal handling, completion-evidence content, audit sample size and vegetation cause-codes are not standardised in the pack.
IEC 61968-6 cl. 4.2 has no component for document management, health and safety, or remote sensing. Notices sit on CS, evidence on MAI, clearances on NO, survey capture on FRD.
ISA Certified Arborist and 'qualified line-clearance arborist' are industry terms. OSHA's defined terms are line-clearance tree trimmer and qualified employee. This specification uses the OSHA terms.
Herbicide and pesticide law is not in the pack. 7.4.3 records that constraint as operator and state, not as a federal IVM standard.
EN 15341 individual O&S names remain paywalled and are cited by group only.

merge_corrections.what: NO CORRECTION NEEDED. Every citation status was already at its ceiling and no EN 17007 citation was under-claimed. This is the first submission in the campaign to need nothing changed at merge.
accepted_from_submitter: 52 Pa. Code 57.198(n)(1) is a 4-to-8 year statewide minimum inspection and treatment cycle for distribution, not a fixed 8 years, and (f) requires a plan including a clearance programme. The Source Authority Pack said 8 years. Verified against the regulation and corrected.
CPUC GO 95 Rule 35 Vegetation Management was missing from the pack, which carried GO 165 inspection only. Verified and added, with Table 1 Cases 13, 14, 13E and 14E and Appendix E.

ANSI A300 Part 7 Integrated Vegetation Management and ANSI Z133 were absent entirely. Added as pack section D-quater, cited as consensus because neither is incorporated by reference into 29 CFR 1910.269.
GFMAM subject 6.5 Maintenance Delivery did not list 7.0. Vegetation IS maintenance delivery; the crosswalk was thin, not the category. Corrected.

Using OSHA's defined terms - line-clearance tree trimmer and qualified employee - rather than the industry's ISA Certified Arborist or qualified line-clearance arborist. Correct, and now recorded in the pack so the next platform does the same.
NERC FAC-003 cited only as a negative, paired with 16 U.S.C. 824o. Exactly the discipline the pack asks for and the first time a platform has done it unprompted.
merge_corrections.models_built_here: Eleven artifacts, 5 BPMN, 5 DMN, 1 CMMN. Grok specified them and cannot build them; only this side has the generator.

merge_corrections.what: citation form: a status may not claim more than the citation string supports. 'clause-verified' without a clause dropped to 'consensus'; an asserted absence dropped to 'judgment'.
